concepts.def: Less than 250mm rainfall/year; large diurnal temperature range; sandy or rocky surfaces; e.g. Sahara, Atacama, Sonoran.
Land degradation in drylands from climate change and human activity (overgrazing, deforestation, over-cultivation); affects Sahel.
Plants adapted to drought: deep tap roots (mesquite), water storage (cacti), waxy leaves; reduce transpiration.
High latitude regions with permanent ice; Arctic (sea ice over ocean) vs Antarctic (ice on continent); minus 60 degrees C possible.
Subarctic biome with permafrost subsoil; short summers allow lichens, mosses, grasses; reindeer, musk ox, lemmings.
Permanently frozen ground covering 25% of Northern Hemisphere; thawing releases methane, threatens infrastructure.
